Package scene

Class SceneBuilder

java.lang.Object
scene.SceneBuilder
public class SceneBuilder extends Object
The SceneBuilder class is responsible for constructing a Scene object from data parsed from an XML file. It uses a SceneDescriptor to hold the parsed attributes and geometries before building the final Scene.

  • Method Details

    • getFilePath

      public static String getFilePath()
      Gets the default file path for the XML scene file. Checks if the file exists before returning the path.
      Returns:
      The file path as a string, or null if the file path is not set or the file does not exist.

    • loadSceneFromFile

      public SceneBuilder loadSceneFromFile(String filePath)
      Loads scene data from the given XML file using a SAX parser and stores it in the internal SceneDescriptor. This method handles potential parsing and I/O exceptions internally, printing their stack traces if they occur.
      Parameters:
      filePath - The path to the XML file containing the scene definition.
      Returns:
      This SceneBuilder instance, allowing for method chaining.

    • build

      public Scene build()
      Builds the Scene object using the parsed data stored in the SceneDescriptor. This method initializes scene properties like background color and ambient light, and adds all defined geometries (spheres and triangles) to the scene.
      Returns:
      The constructed Scene object.

      private Color parseColor(String colorStr)

      Returns:
      The parsed Color object.
      Throws:
      NumberFormatException - if any part of the color string is not a valid integer.
